shellCommands.command: git status --short && ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null | head -80 && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | grep -v '.agents/' | head -200

cat src/App.tsx && echo ---MAIN--- && cat src/main.tsx && echo ---IDX--- && cat index.html && echo ---AGENTS--- && cat AGENTS.md && echo ---TSC--- && cat tsconfig.json && echo ---VITE--- && cat vite.config.ts && echo ---GITIGNORE--- && cat .gitignore && echo ---PKG--- && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/ && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"' && ls .agents/skills/gravity-ui/ .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules

grep -n -i -A6 'date-components\|date-utils' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | sed -n 1,120p; echo ---; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | head -150; echo ---; ls .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts; npm view @gravity-ui/date-components version 2>&1 | tail -3; npm view @gravity-ui/date-components@latest peerDependencies 2>&1; npm view @gravity-ui/date-utils version 2>&1 | tail -2

npm view @gravity-ui/date-components versions --json 2>/dev/null | tail -40; for v in 4 3 2; do echo "== $v"; npm view @gravity-ui/date-components@$v peerDependencies --json 2>/dev/null | tail -20; done

npm install @gravity-ui/date-components@^4.1.0 @gravity-ui/date-utils@^2.6.0 2>&1 | grep -v 'npm warn Unknown env' | tail -15; grep -A12 '"dependencies"' package.json; node -e "for (const p of ['@gravity-ui/date-components','@gravity-ui/date-utils','@gravity-ui/uikit']) console.log(p, require('./node_modules/'+p+'/package.json').version)"

bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh date-components Calendar DatePicker 2>&1 | head -80; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/docs 2>/dev/null

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components && cat dist/docs/INDEX.md | head -150; echo ---; ls dist/docs/components; echo ---README; grep -n -i -A12 'required setup\|setup' README.md | head -80

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui && ls date-components/dist/esm/components/Calendar/ 2>/dev/null; f=$(grep -rl "onUpdate" date-components/dist/esm --include=*.d.ts | grep -i 'calendar' | head -3); echo "$f"; for x in $f; do echo "== $x"; head -60 $x; done; echo ---DU; grep -n "export" date-utils/dist/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30; ls date-utils/dist | head -30

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm/components/Calendar/Calendar.d.ts | head -40; echo ---; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/; grep -rn "export declare function dateTime\b\|export declare function dateTimeParse\|format(" node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/build/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils -name "*.d.ts" | head -5

grep -n "format\|toDate\|export" node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/build/typings/dateTime.d.ts | head -40; grep -n "dateTime\b\|dateTimeParse" node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/build/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/build/typings/index.d.ts | head; grep -n "CalendarValueType\|onUpdate" node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm/components/CalendarView/hooks/types.d.ts | head; grep -n "onUpdate" -B2 -A4 node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm/components/CalendarView/hooks/types.d.ts | head -40; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm/components/CalendarView/hooks/useCalendarState.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30

bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Flex Text Box ThemeProvider 2>&1 | head -20; grep -n "direction\|alignItems\|color\b" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build -path '*Text*' -name '*.d.ts' | head -3; grep -rn "onUpdate" node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm/components/types/*.d.ts | head -5; grep -rln "format(" node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/README.md && grep -n "format(" node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/README.md | head -5
npm run build 2>&1 | grep -v 'npm warn' | tail -40
rm -rf dist && npx tsc --noEmit && echo TSC_OK; git status --short; grep -n "date-components\|date-utils" package.json
